tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground; cards sitting on a powder block. In the Ink theme it is the black block itself (logo strips, testimonials, stats, footer).

tokens.name: surface-fog
tokens.usage: Quiet gray block ground and feature-card fill (with a 1px `line` border). Use for a 'calm' section between a powder block and an ink block.

tokens.name: powder
tokens.usage: THE signature colour. Hero and feature section grounds, image/illustration panes, doodle fills, the highlight box behind a key phrase, big stat numerals on ink. Same value in both themes.

tokens.name: powder-50
tokens.usage: Powder at 50% on paper. Second fill inside illustrations (lens, chart area), the faded state of a stacked card, hover tint on paper rows. Never as text ground for long copy.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text, every outline and every doodle stroke. Text on `surface`, `surface-fog` (21:1 / 19:1 in Paper; 21:1 / 19:1 in Ink).

tokens.name: on-powder
tokens.usage: Text and strokes on a `powder` or `powder-50` ground, in both themes (14:1 on powder).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Small labels on ink blocks (footer column heads, captions): 6.4:1 on black. On paper it is only 3.3:1 — allowed for 24px+ text or decorative strokes only; never small body copy on white.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairline around fog feature cards and table rows. Decorative separation only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: 1px outline of secondary buttons, the Log-in button, sketchy frames around illustrations. Follows `ink` per theme.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Black on paper/powder/fog (≥13:1), powder on ink blocks (15:1).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: a big centred section title, often with a scribble underline. Defined at a 1920px viewport; scale fluidly (≈4.48vw, min 44px).

styles.name: display-l
styles.sample: Turn scattered notes into clear answers
styles.usage: Hero headline, centred, max 2 lines, tight leading (0.96). Pair with a scribble ellipse around 1–3 key words. ≈3.75vw, min 40px.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.sample: Most of the work happens before the meeting
styles.usage: Section headline, left-aligned beside an illustration or centred above a grid. ≈2.92vw, min 34px.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numerals on an ink block, coloured `powder`, with a body-l label under them in `ink`.

styles.name: heading-m
styles.usage: Hero sub-line (use 600 there), card titles in a 3-up grid, small section titles. Interpuncts ( · ) separate short claims.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: See the whole picture and decide what to do next.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs, hero body (centred, max ~34ch), text links with an arrow ( → ).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: UPPERCASE kicker above every headline (text-transform comes from bundle.css). Never bold, never coloured.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every number links back to where it came from.
styles.usage: Default body copy, card descriptions, nav links.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Footer links and column heads, captions, legal.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the small outline (Log in) button.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the header CTA.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of every button.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: THE layout rhythm: inset of every rounded section block from the viewport edge, the gap between stacked blocks, and the gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: Inner padding of feature cards and product cards.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Vertical padding inside a hero/section block (≈7vw; min 64px on mobile).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the content column inside a block (three 480px cards + two gutters).

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Small outline button (Log in), input fields.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: All CTA buttons, chips, the highlight box behind a phrase.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Section blocks, feature cards, product cards, image panes. The defining corner of the system.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Rare: one oversized pill element per page at most.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars, logo discs in illustrations, node dots.

shadow.note: The system is flat: depth comes from solid black inked offsets in illustrations, not from shadows. These three are the only shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating chat/help launcher and other fixed floating controls.

tokens.name: glow-ai
tokens.usage: The ONLY soft glow: around an AI prompt input (Ask bar).

stroke.note: Line weights used inside doodles and illustrations.

tokens.name: stroke-hatch
tokens.usage: Hatching, ruled lines inside documents, motion lines.

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: Default outline of every doodle, card and icon in an illustration.

tokens.name: stroke-bold
tokens.usage: Emphasis outline: the main object of a spot illustration, arrows.

tokens.name: stroke-scribble
tokens.usage: Hand-drawn ellipse/underline around words in a headline.

easing.note: Use these exact curves; don't approximate them with ease-in-out.

tokens.name: ease-scroll
tokens.usage: Scroll-linked rise/slide-in of blocks and illustrations.

tokens.name: ease-float
tokens.usage: Looping bob/sway of floating doodles; rotate-in entrances.

tokens.name: ease-stack
tokens.usage: A stacked card receding (scale 0.95, opacity 0.5) as the next covers it.

tokens.name: ease-spin
tokens.usage: Continuous 360° spin of small confetti shapes.

tokens.name: dur-hover
tokens.usage: Button hover (opacity/fill), linear.

tokens.name: dur-nav
tokens.usage: Menu items sliding/fading in, staggered ~20–50ms.

tokens.name: dur-draw
tokens.usage: Scribble draw-on (intentional addition, see Motion).

tokens.name: dur-float
tokens.usage: One leg of a doodle bob/sway (alternate, infinite).

tokens.name: dur-spin
tokens.usage: One full turn of a spinning confetti shape.

tokens.name: opacity-hover
tokens.usage: Primary (ink) button on hover.

tokens.name: opacity-recede
tokens.usage: A stacked card once the next card covers it.
